thread:
Alex M: Hey folks — planning to enable geo-fallback to eu-west-1 for production traffic (region fallback when primary is overloaded). Want to do a canary first (5% of eligible EU requests), with sticky routing for session affinity. Need signoffs and ops checks before flipping.
Tara: Quick Q — what do we want for stickiness TTL? Also we should make sure KV cache affinity is preserved so we don’t thrash caches.
Samir: Recommend canary config: 5% EU origin for eligible requests, 1% cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 on error paths. Stickiness keyed on `user_id` with 24h TTL. Guardrails: p50 latency < 250ms, error rate < 0.5% during the 30m canary window. If p95 > 700ms or error_rate > 1% for 2m -> rollback.
Jin: Draft of the flag payload I'll apply (will post command 5m before):
```
{
  "flag": "geo_fallback_eu",
  "stage": "canary",
  "percent": 5,
  "stickiness": {"type":"user_id","ttl":"24h"},
  "fallback_model": "redwood-gpt-eu-v1",
  "cache_affinity": true,
  "min_available_replicas": 2
}
```
I'll push via `/flag update geo_fallback_eu --json file.json` and target 10:30 PDT.
Tara: Add KV cache prewarm for the canary buckets (script queued). If we don't prewarm, initial canary traffic will see cold cache penalty and skew telemetry.
Lina: I'll wire up dashboards and alerts: latency by region/model, failover_rate, cache_hit_ratio, and model-mismatch-rate. Proposed alert thresholds:
- p95 latency > 700ms
- error rate > 1% sustained for 2m
- failover_rate > 10% for 5m
- model_mismatch_rate > 0.5%
If any fire, page oncall and set flag percent=0.
Samir: Rollback plan (simple): set `percent` -> 0, disable stickiness migration, run quick health check: `./scripts/check_geo_failover.sh --region eu-west-1 --quick`. If rollback is insufficient, trigger incident and rollback traffic routing at the gateway.
OpsBot: [automated] config-change queued by Jin: `geo_fallback_eu` -> canary 5% (ts=1794073452).
DeployBot: Gate scheduled: 2026-03-18T10:30:00-07:00 (10:30 PDT). Auto-monitor window = 30m.
Alex M: Owners: Samir (runtime + rollback), Tara (cache/prewarm), Lina (monitoring/alerts), Jin (flag execution). I'll flip at 10:30 if no blockers — react with :thumbsup: to approve.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Tara: :thumbsup: prewarm job started.
Lina: :thumbsup: dashboards phased in, metrics look healthy pre-rollout.
Jin: I'll post the exact rollout command and the `kubectl` patch in this thread 5m prior.
Alex M: Note — ensure fallback model tokenizer versions match. If we detect tokenization/model-version mismatch, immediate rollback + incident call. Also watch for increased token usage (cost spike) during the canary.
Samir: Also add a short chaos check: simulate degraded primary (10% error injection) in a single canary shard and verify fallback correctness. Run after flag at +10m.
Lina: I'll create a single-pane status view with the canary shard metrics and a one-click rollback link (dashboard action ties to the flag API).
Alex M: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, I'll execute at 10:30 PDT. Will follow up with a 30m post-rollout summary here.
